info.title: RankRaft AI API
info.description: Read your AI visibility data and manage the prompts RankRaft tracks. Available on the Enterprise plan. Authenticate with an organization API key in the `X-API-Key` header.

tags.name: Discovery
tags.description: The key, its organization, and the sites and engines it can read.

tags.description: The questions RankRaft asks the engines every day.

tags.name: Reports

tags.name: Agent Analytics
tags.description: AI crawler and AI referral traffic from your server logs.

tags.name: Action Center
tags.description: What to do next, and what was measured.

post.description: Add up to 100 prompts. A prompt whose text already exists (ignoring case and spacing) is returned as it is rather than duplicated, so retrying is safe. Active prompts count against the plan's cap; a request that would exceed it is refused whole. `dry_run` validates and reports without writing.

market.description: Location appended to the question when it is asked, e.g. `Pakistan`. Null uses the site's market.

patch.description: Change a prompt's category or market. Text cannot be edited: a reworded question is a different question, so disable the old prompt and create a new one, which keeps answer history comparable.

post.description: Visibility Score and its components for your brand — or for you and your competitors — over a date range, optionally grouped by date, platform, prompt or category. Identical to the numbers on the dashboard for the same range.

brands.description: `owned` (your brand), `all` (you plus confirmed competitors, ranked), or a list of brand names.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

rank.description: Position by Visibility Score among you and your confirmed competitors, within this row's group.

visibility_score.description: 0–100: 45% mention rate, 35% citation rate, 20% prompt coverage.

mention_rate.description: 0–1: share of answers naming the brand.

citation_rate.description: 0–1: share of answers linking to the brand's site.

prompt_coverage.description: 0–1: share of prompts where the brand was named at least once.

average_position.description: Average order of first mention when named (1 = first). Null when never named.

share_of_voice.description: 0–1: the brand's share of all brand mentions (you plus confirmed competitors).

post.description: Which domains or pages the engines linked to in answers to your prompts, who owns them (you, a competitor, a third party) and what kind of site they are. Ranked by the number of answers citing each one.

source_kind.description: forum, video, review, roundup, editorial, marketplace, reference, social, publishing, recipe, brand or unknown.

answers.description: Distinct answers citing it. One page linked twice in an answer is one answer.

citation_share.description: 0–1: its share of all citations in the same group.
